properties.displayName: [WEEKLY] AI-Agent Server (PraisonAI/MCP) Spawns OS Shell or Recon LOLBin — Unauthenticated RCE Exploitation
properties.description:
Detects an LLM/agent-runtime server process (python/uvicorn/gunicorn/node) that is hosting a PraisonAI or MCP service spawning an OS shell, network utility, or reconnaissance LOLBin as a child — the convergent post-exploitation signal across this fortnight's 12 critical PraisonAI advisories (GHSA-4869-x4pr-q22x Jobs-API RCE, GHSA-p75f-6fp4-p57w UI MCP-connect command injection, GHSA-p69m/-vmmj codeMode sandbox escape, GHSA-892r/-9752 unauthenticated AgentOS, GHSA-x227 MCP SSE 0.0.0.0 bind, GHSA-f38v hardcoded JWT). Every one of those bugs ends the same way: a network-reachable, auth-bypassed agent endpoint coerces the host runtime into executing attacker-chosen code, which surfaces as the agent parent process forking a shell/recon binary it would never normally launch. The UC spans exploit→execution of the kill chain: the unauthenticated request is the entry, the anomalous child process is the detection. It FIRES when an agent-runtime parent whose command line references praisonai/agentos/aiui/mcp spawns sh/bash/cmd/powershell/curl/whoami/id/etc.; it does NOT fire on the agent serving normal HTTP, on package-manager subprocess builds (pip/npm/node-gyp), or on shells spawned by non-agent parents. Because it keys on the parent identity + child class rather than any single advisory's IOC, it stays valid as new PraisonAI CVEs and exploit payloads land.

Rationale: All 12 advisories differ in entry vector (Jobs API, AgentOS, MCP SSE/HTTP, recipe-serve, codeMode, UI connect) but converge on the same observable: an unauthenticated/auth-bypassed agent runtime executing attacker-controlled OS commands, so keying on the agent-runtime parent + shell/recon child catches the joint TTP independent of which CVE or payload is used.
properties.query:
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(14d)
| where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ ("python","python3","python.exe","node","node.exe","uvicorn","gunicorn","pwsh","pwsh.exe")
| where InitiatingProcessCommandLine has_any ("praisonai","agentos","aiui","recipe serve","jobs.server","praisonai_platform","mcp")
| where FileName in~ ("sh","bash","dash","zsh","ksh","cmd.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","curl","curl.exe","wget","nc","ncat","socat","whoami","id","uname","certutil.exe","base64","chmod")
| where AccountName !endswith "$"
| where not(ProcessCommandLine has_any ("pip install","npm install","node-gyp"))
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessCommandLine, FileName, FolderPath, ProcessCommandLine, SHA256, InitiatingProcessTokenElevation
| order by Timestamp desc
